name: @pond-ts/process
description: Computations as data over pond-ts: processing graphs authored fluently or composed as JSON, resolved against a declared op vocabulary with content-addressed caching, provenance, and per-node timings. Experimental, pre-1.0.

scripts.prepack: cp ../../LICENSE ./LICENSE && cp ../../CHANGELOG.md ./CHANGELOG.md && npm run build && cp cjs-fallback.cjs dist/cjs-fallback.cjs && find dist -name '*.map' -delete
scripts.test: npm run test:type && npm run test:dts && npm run test:runtime
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run build && npm test
